For placement of order, the OEM [Principal Firm] directly or through authorized dealers shall have succe ssfully executed a contract for supply of Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) to any Govt organization/PSU/P PP Project of minimum 10 percent of the advertised value of the bid [Bid Value – 16942.40] during previous 3 years. This period of 3 years shall be counted with respect to date of tender closing. In this regard, Firms should submit a past performance document in the form of CRN/CRAC/R-NOTE/completion certificate issue d by competent authority of that Govt organization/PSU/PPP Project along with PO.
